# Knovas Assistent

> The one company assistant of the Platform's Workspace, which answers a signed-in person's question only from the passages that person's own search returns, shows only statements whose references it could check, and keeps that person's past chats.

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Aliases | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-1` | `RESP-01` | Answers a signed-in person's question from passages the Brain returned to that person, with a checked reference per statement. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/assistant` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-2` |  | Past chats (W-07): what a person asked and the answers as they were shown, with their references, stored in the Platform's own database in new tables only, listed, opened and deleted by their owner only (plan § 5.2), and deleted by themselves 90 days after their last message (PMVP-23, decision D3). | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/identity/chats.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/identity/migrations/0026_assistant_chats.sql` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-3` |  | The ask page (W-01, W-03, PMVP-22a): POST /fragen takes the question from the search page's box, asks the service once for the signed-in person and shows the reply: each statement with its reference, which opens the statement's quote right under it; the passages; no answer with the closest passages; busy or failed as the plain message. The switch Fragen / Suchen beside the box (ask.js) sends a question there and leaves searching to the search page. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/assistant_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/ask.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/css/ask.css`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/js/ask.js` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-4` |  | Its own claim (RB-6): the assistant is a member of roles, and every Core call of an answer (the search, the document-fields probe inside it, the generation) carries the claim the Platform signs for it, narrowed to the signed-in person (its roles' groups and functions that she also holds), and declares the actor {kind: agent, id: the assistant, on_behalf_of: the person}. Without the assistant's claim it answers failed; it never falls back to the person's own claim. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/assistant_routes.py` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-5` |  | Chats on the page (W-06, W-07, PMVP-23): an answered question becomes the person's chat. She reads it again as it was answered, asks on in it (the earlier turns go to the service as their text, the search is the chat's last question and the follow-up together), opens a stored reference's document after the Core says she may, deletes it, and finds her chats in the Workspace's sidebar (the newest 20, which the route hands to the shell's partial) and on the page of all chats. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/assistant_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/ask.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/css/ask.css`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/js/ask.js`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/identity/chats.py` |

### Not responsible for

- Reading documents any other way than through the person's own search and, for the passages that search returned, the text of those documents around each hit, under the founder's five limits of 2026-11-22 (PMVP-20 context; plan § 5.2, step 2, POST-02 as amended).
- Deciding who may see a document; the Brain's search does, as the signed-in person.
- The search page and the document view; they belong to the Platform's web app (index.html draws the box and the switch only when the ask page says the assistant is on).
- Opening a document from a reference; the web app's file routes serve what retrieval handed the person.

### Terms

- reference (a number in an answer that points to a passage retrieved for this person in this chat)
- passage (a hit's verbatim text that the person's search returned, or up to 1,200 characters of the text around it read from that document (PMVP-20 context), numbered in search order)
- chat (one person's questions and the answers as they were shown, with their references)
- follow-up (a question asked in a chat, after its earlier turns)

## Uses

| Component | Operations | Expects | Method | Protocol |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-BRAIN-API` |  |  | POST /secured/query (the person's own search), GET /secured/document/&lt;uuid>/text (the text around each hit, only for the documents that search returned, under the founder's limits of 2026-11-22; PMVP-20 context) and POST /secured/llm/generate (one whole answer, no streaming), through the Platform's client (knovas_client.py) on the Platform's certificate, as the Knovas Assistent for the signed-in person: its own claim narrowed to her and the declared actor (plan § 5.2; RB-6) | HTTPS with mTLS |
| `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API` | `messages` | `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API/messages/P-1`; `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API/messages/P-2` | when the customer chose anthropic (assistant.provider): the official SDK (anthropic==2.12.0), client.beta.messages.create, on the key and the model of the settings registry, with the system instruction and the composed messages only (POST-02; the passages are the contexts around the hits since PMVP-20 context); one call per answer, and one per «Verbindung testen» with invented text (src/assistant/providers.py, PMVP-25) | HTTPS |
| `EXT-MCP-GATEWAY` | `mcp` |  | not called by the Platform itself: with «Brain-Werkzeuge» (assistant.mode brain_mcp) Anthropic's MCP connector calls the gateway's search and fetch for Claude, with the company's gateway key the Platform puts into the request (assistant.brain_mcp_key, to assistant.brain_mcp_url on knovas.ch); the gateway reads with that key, without the person's groups (src/assistant/providers.py, brain_tools.py; PMVP-20 brain-mcp) | HTTPS (from Anthropic) |

## Hides

- The layout of the tables assistant_chats, assistant_messages and assistant_references (migration 0026).
- How an answer is kept in its message (one JSON object, version 1) and drawn again from it.
- How the prompt is worded and how an answer is split into statements before the check.
- Which provider writes the answer; the service and the check take the same generate either way.
- How «Brain-Werkzeuge» turn the gateway's tool results into passages and a document's title into a passage number before the unchanged check.

## Decisions and risks

### Decisions

| Id | Statement |
|---|---|
| `FU-14` | No Alloy model for POST-02 (the founder, 2026-11-19): the assistant gets document content only through the Brain's search, which enforces access. |
| `PMVP-20-context` | The founder, 2026-11-22 ("Yes, with limits"): the assistant may read the Core's document-text route for the documents the person's own search just returned, under five limits (only those documents; the Core decides every read and any failure keeps the snippet; as the person; bounded; no text in logs). POST-02 is amended to them; Core request CR-1 is not needed for the pilot. |

### Risks

| Id | Statement | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-01` | The check catches a reference number that matches no passage, not one that matches the wrong passage (plan § 7, risks). | The test questions measure it (plan § 11), and the page always shows the passage under the sentence, so the reader sees the evidence itself. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-02` | POST-02 keeps the prompt to what the person's search returns; the search follows the person's rights only where a customer's enforcement is on, and it is off for every tenant today (plan § 3). | No customer is switched to enforcement «Ein» before the Core's end-to-end rights test has passed twice (plan § 8.1, DEC-0082). |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-04` | The document-text route takes no claim on a GET yet (Core request CR-1c): it resolves the principal from the certificate alone, so under disabled it reads every document as the search does, under enforcing open documents only, and under brokered it refuses every read (401). The context then reads at most what the tenant's posture lets an unnamed caller read, never a document the search did not return. | Only documents this question's search returned are read, and a refusal keeps the snippet; CR-1c makes the read narrow exactly as the person's search does; until then «Ein» (brokered) means snippets only. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-03` | With anthropic chosen (the founder, 2026-11-21: the Platform calls the language model itself and the customer chooses the provider; the pilot chose Anthropic), the passages the person's search returned (since PMVP-20 context up to 1,200 characters around each hit), the question and its history leave the installation for Anthropic; while enforcement is off (RISK-02) they may hold passages beyond the person's rights. The key is a secret of the installation. | Off and knovas by default; only an administrator chooses anthropic and enters the key; the key is sealed with the deployment's settings key and never shown or logged; PMVP-25 is critical under the repository's CLAUDE.md, so management approves it before main. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-04` | With «Brain-Werkzeuge» (assistant.mode brain_mcp; the founder, 2026-11-22) the Knovas MCP gateway reads with the company's key, without the person's groups: Claude may read and cite documents the asking person may not see, whatever enforcement says; the company's gateway key and whole fetched documents pass through Anthropic. | Off by default (passages); only an administrator chooses it, with anthropic and both keys; the settings page shows the warning «… Nur ohne «Ein» verwenden.» under the mode; the page never grants such an answer's documents (a stored chat opens one after the Core's check as the person); critical, so management approves before main. CR-R5/CR-R6 would let the gateway read as the person. |

## To review

| At | Why |
|---|---|
| `/owner` | Proposed owner, as for every card in this repository; one role per component is confirmed by a person (Software Map K4). |
